# Inspirec

> > Inspirec is a trusted global recruitment consultancy and talent advisory firm specializing in permanent hiring, AI-driven screening, and inclusive employer branding solutions.

Inspirec is a UK-based recruitment consultancy headquartered in Gravesend, Kent, offering expert talent acquisition and recruitment insights. The company leverages AI-driven screening tools and Applicant Tracking Systems to deliver comprehensive hiring and career advisory services across multiple markets including the Middle East.

## Key Topics

- Recruitment Consultancy
- Talent Acquisition
- AI-driven Screening Tools
- Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
- Employer Branding
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Inclusive Employer-Branding
- Talent Advisory
- Recruitment Services
- Career Advice
- Corporate Responsibility
- Recruitment Insights
- CV Writing
- Recruiter Interview
